summary: Booking corrected FCFS-only -> reservable online since July 2026; count 50 -> 29; added $30, 50 amp, facilities, 14-night limit. Season confirmed. Lakefront stands for about 5 sites of 29.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront stands, on about 5-6 of 29 sites, thin margin. Measured on 0.33 m/px imagery: pads on the lake side of the upper loop road (north row, at about 42.3066,-96.3249) reach about 35-45 m from the riprap shore, across open grass with scattered trees; the loop road is on their landward side. A narrow shore path serves the jetties; it doesn't look like a road; no driveway or day use between except that path. Beach is about 300 m west, not in the way. All other sites sit behind that row and across the loop road, 100+ m. No official site photos show water from a pad (the gallery's camper shot is of an older loop with no lake in view). If AWH reads the shore path as day use, this goes to lakeview.
